content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad charge steep fees, up to 10% per sale, which can significantly cut into your earnings. In contrast, using NOWPayments for crypto transactions incurs only a 0.5% fee. This means that for every 100 sales at $97, you retain an additional $921 compared to using a platform that charges higher fees. By leveraging infrastructure that puts the creator in control, you can ensure more revenue stays in your pocket, enabling you to reinvest in your work.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital commerce stack, gather your essential tools: a domain for your store, GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and NOWPayments for processing transactions. You’ll also need a reliable method for product delivery, such as Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Familiarize yourself with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Having these components ready will streamline your setup process and ensure a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by creating your online store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure NOWPayments for your crypto payment processing. You will need to integrate this with your chosen backend logic solution, such as Google Apps Script, which will handle payment confirmations and trigger product delivery automatically. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for hosting your digital products, ensuring that customers receive their downloads instantly upon payment confirmation.
Avoid platform fees and maximize your revenue with crypto payments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set, it’s time to go live. Test your setup by processing a test transaction through NOWPayments, ensuring that everything operates smoothly. Make sure your digital products are properly linked and that the delivery mechanism triggers correctly. Once verified, start promoting your store on social media and leverage your network to drive initial traffic. Monitor transactions closely to address any issues that may arise during your first sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your infrastructure operational, focus on scaling your digital product offerings. Expand your product catalog by adding more items and explore different digital formats. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access additional blueprints and templates that can enhance your store. Consider optimizing your marketing strategies to reach a wider audience and increase sales volume, thereby maximizing your revenue while minimizing platform dependence.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, leverage crypto payment processing through NOWPayments. This allows you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, preserving more of your profit. With a setup that includes automatic delivery and order management, you can effectively monetize your digital products without traditional platform limitations.
Take control of your digital product sales with complete ownership.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This comprehensive package provides all the blueprints and templates needed to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more information on products, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I start selling digital products online?

Begin by setting up your own online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you retain more profit. Finally, prepare your products for delivery using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
What are the costs associated with selling digital products?

Using NOWPayments incurs a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. This means more revenue stays in your pocket, maximizing your profits on each sale.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using traditional platforms?

Yes, by using a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can sell templates and fonts directly from your own website. This setup allows you to handle payments and delivery on your terms, without reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
Is it difficult to set up my own digital product store?

Setting up your own digital product store is straightforward with the right tools. By following structured steps and utilizing free resources like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a fully functional store without technical expertise.
What digital products are best to sell?

Ebooks, online courses, templates, fonts, presets, and software are all excellent digital products to sell. Choose items that resonate with your audience and leverage your expertise to create valuable offerings.
